An '''MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser'''<ref name="Liberty" /> participated in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Battle of Pallaxides|battle]] against [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pallaxides]]<ref name="Empire Lost 3" /> in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="Date">The events of [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 3]] are set approximately thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which marks the beginning of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''Empire Lost 3'' must have taken place around [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref>
